questions.question: Why is it important to speak English in today's globalized world?
options: It's not important at all
English is the only language that matters
English is a universal language for communication and business
Other languages are more important
questions.correct_answer: English is a universal language for communication and business

questions.question: What is the best way to improve your English speaking skills?
options: Only read English books
Practice speaking with native speakers
Watch movies in your native language
Avoid speaking English as much as possible

questions.question: What is a common challenge for non-native English speakers when trying to speak fluently?
options: Having a strong accent is an advantage
Misunderstanding the importance of grammar
Using too many idioms and slang
Not having enough vocabulary

questions.question: What is the benefit of immersing yourself in an English-speaking environment?
options: It has no impact on language skills
It leads to slower language acquisition
It enhances language learning by constant exposure
It only benefits native speakers
questions.correct_answer: It enhances language learning by constant exposure

questions.question: Which of the following is a common motivation for people to learn English?
options: To isolate themselves from the global community
To gain access to a wider range of opportunities and experiences
To stick to their native language
To avoid using technology
questions.correct_answer: To gain access to a wider range of opportunities and experiences
